blinding_guess.why: Every yaml.load / yaml.load_all call in the snapshot omits the Loader argument (grep for Loader=, SafeLoader, FullLoader, safe_load returns no load call with a loader; only yaml.safe_dump is used in rosmsg/param_dump), and add_constructor/add_implicit_resolver register on the default loaders; this relies on the pre-PyYAML-5.1 default loader and conflicts with PyYAML >=5.1 (YAMLLoadWarning) and 6.0 (Loader required).

notes: All seven packet elements are PyYAML module-level APIs that ros_comm consumes; it provides none, so declares and not_declared are empty.
